overview: Coco is a 2017 American animated fantasy film directed by Lee Unkrich, and written by Adrian Molina and Matthew Aldrich. Produced by Pixar Animation Studios for Walt Disney Pictures, the film stars the voices of Anthony Gonzalez, Gael García Bernal, Benjamin Bratt, Alanna Ubach, Renée Victor, Ana Ofelia Murguía and Edward James Olmos. It follows a 12-year-old boy in Mexico named Miguel (Gonzalez) who is accidentally transported to the Land of the Dead, where he seeks the help of his deceased musician great-great-grandfather to return him to his family and reverse their ban on music.
